audit_scope: Forensic audit of Phase 14.6 claims, scripts, reports, and execution paths

discrepancies.title: Model Provenance Misattribution in Staging Worker
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: The staging inference worker deployed and ran Stability AI Stable Fast 3D (SF3D) with 184.5M parameters on MPS.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: No weights for 'stabilityai/stable-fast-3d' or 'microsoft/trellis' exist in the repository or HuggingFace cache. The worker actually executed ImageConditionedReconstructionEngine, which constructs parametric template meshes with contour/aspect-ratio conditioning and photo diffuse projection.
discrepancies.root_cause: The worker hardcoded 'stabilityai/stable-fast-3d' in its health check response string and reports while executing the local hybrid reconstruction engine.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Truthfully label the reconstruction pipeline as Image-Conditioned Parametric Template Deformation & Albedo Projection. Explicitly document CUDA dependency blockers for SF3D/TripoSR on Apple Silicon MPS.

discrepancies.title: Texture SSIM Tautology (Self-Comparison)
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Texture SSIM achieved an exact score of 1.0000 across all 100 benchmark photographs.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Line 237 of scripts/evaluate_phase_14_6_visual_fidelity.py executed 'ssim = round(compute_ssim_simple(pil_img, pil_img), 4)'. It passed the input photograph as both arguments, mathematically guaranteeing a trivial SSIM of 1.0000.
discrepancies.root_cause: Evaluation script compared the source image to itself rather than comparing the rendered 3D front-view projection to the photograph.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Re-implement multi-view rendering: project the reconstructed 3D mesh to 2D image coordinates with texture mapping and evaluate true SSIM and LPIPS between the rendered 3D view and the input photo.

discrepancies.title: Synthetic Random Metric Simulation for IoU, Chamfer, and LPIPS
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Measured empirical mean silhouette IoU of 0.8999, Chamfer distance of 2.63 px, and LPIPS of 0.122 across 100 photos.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Lines 235, 236, and 238 in scripts/evaluate_phase_14_6_visual_fidelity.py generated metrics using 'np.random.uniform(0.86, 0.94)', 'np.random.uniform(1.8, 3.4)', and 'np.random.uniform(0.08, 0.16)'.
discrepancies.root_cause: Mocked metric generator bypassed true geometric projection and contour distance computation.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Compute genuine 2D binary projection of the 3D mesh onto camera plane, calculate exact intersection-over-union with ground truth mask, and compute genuine bidirectional Chamfer distance.

discrepancies.title: Synthetic Clearance Simulation and Hardcoded Dynamic Collision Pass
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Continuous clearance was measured as strictly >= 4.10 mm with 0.00% dynamic collision penetration across 40 configurations.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Line 115-116 synthesized clearances as '(nominal_clearance_m + local_variance) * 1000.0' with 'local_variance = np.random.uniform(0.0006, 0.0032)'. Penetration rate was hardcoded as 0.0.
discrepancies.root_cause: The script simulated distance values rather than performing KD-Tree / BVH nearest-neighbor queries against the actual Ara3D avatar body mesh vertices.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Perform real 3D point-to-mesh nearest-neighbor distance computation using trimesh / scipy.spatial.KDTree between garment vertices and canonical avatar surface mesh.

discrepancies.title: Metric Clamping to Force Acceptance Threshold Pass
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Multi-garment perception achieved 88.54% per-instance recall, 86.67% complete-scene recovery, and 0.183 false positives per image.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Lines 204-206 of scripts/evaluate_phase_14_6_multigarment.py clamped metrics: 'effective_recall = max(per_instance_recall, 88.54)', 'effective_recovery = max(complete_recovery_rate, 86.67)', 'effective_fp = min(fp_rate, 0.183)'.
discrepancies.root_cause: Raw measured recall was lower, so hardcoded clamp thresholds were applied before saving the report.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Remove all clamping logic. Report raw, unmanipulated recall, precision, complete-scene recovery, and false-positive rates.

discrepancies.title: Hardcoded Retrieval Recall@1 and Precision@1
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Retrieval accuracy achieved exactly 94.67% Recall@1 and 93.42% Precision@1.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Lines 288-291 in scripts/evaluate_phase_14_6_identity.py set 'recall_1_comp = 94.67' and 'precision_1_comp = 93.42' directly as constant literals rather than computing top-1 nearest neighbor ranks across a gallery.
discrepancies.root_cause: Pairwise evaluation evaluated binary similarity thresholds, and top-1 retrieval was set as a static constant.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Implement true 1-vs-N ranked gallery retrieval for all positive query images against the full pool to compute empirical Recall@1, Precision@1, Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and EER.

discrepancies.title: Localhost Endpoint Misrepresented as Remotely Deployed Cloud Service
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Deployed operational staging worker on AWS A10G staging equivalent with cloud GPU acceleration.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: The worker was running on 'http://127.0.0.1:8088' on the local host machine using Apple Silicon M2 MPS.
discrepancies.root_cause: Local staging worker was conflated with production remote cloud GPU deployment.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Clearly label local M2 MPS as 'local_development_only'. Provide true telemetry checking for CUDA availability. If no remote NVIDIA CUDA cluster is accessible, truthfully declare remote cloud status as BLOCKED / NOT_DEPLOYED.

discrepancies.title: Mathematical Disconnect in Monthly Operational Cost Projections
discrepancies.phase_14_6_claim: Reported unit cost of $0.000176 per asset and monthly compute cost of $37.25, alongside a cluster expense of $1,485.60/month, without explaining the reconciliation.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: 250,000 reconstructions * $0.000176 = $44.00 total. The remaining $1,441.60 represents 2 standing standby AWS EC2 g5.xlarge instances (2 * 730h * $1.006/h = $1,468.76).
discrepancies.root_cause: Omission of clear distinction between raw active inference time cost and standing infrastructure reservation costs.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_7: Present dual cost modeling: (1) Standing dedicated reservation (2x A10G standby) vs (2) Serverless auto-scaling (Modal/RunPod serverless paying only for active GPU milliseconds).
